name: Casanova Lerrone (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a broad blue band, white at the hoist and yellow at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Casanova Lerrone, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.
